guesses.reason: The fluffy white body coat, broad puppy head, and tan-and-dark facial 'badger' markings on the ears and head are classic Pyrenees puppy traits.
The blue-gray eyes, folded ears, and brown-and-black tricolor mask hint at a herding-breed contribution.
The darker muzzle shading and dense pale coat are consistent with a livestock-guardian mix.

breed.appearance: A fluffy, sturdy puppy with a mostly white, medium-length coat and a white blaze running from the forehead down over the muzzle. The ears and the sides of the head are rich golden-brown with black shading on the ear tips and around the eyes, giving a soft mask effect, and the soft drop ears fold forward. Grace has striking blue-gray eyes, a black nose, a little pink tongue peeking out, and big chunky white paws.
breed.fun_fact: Great Pyrenees are gentle giants bred to guard flocks, so they are famously calm, loyal, and protective of their families!
